# Awakening the Spine Through Kriya Yoga

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and blessings. Today, Brother Chidananda reflects on the profound significance of the spinal highway. In the yoga philosophy, the spine is the altar of God. Through the study of Kriya Yoga, we learn the art of withdrawing our energy from the senses and redirecting it up the spine to awaken the higher centers of consciousness.

### The Altar of the Divine

All human perceptions and experiences are processed through the spine and brain. When our energy is directed outward, we perceive only the duality of the material world. Kriya Yoga teaches us to magnetize the spine, drawing the life force inward to reveal the absolute light of Spirit.

### Breaking Free from Habitual Trances

By practicing the scientific methods taught by Yogananda, we break free from the subconscious ruts of habits and karma. The spine is charged with cosmic energy, elevating our daily mood and giving us tremendous willpower.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Spinal Awareness:** Keep your spine erect during work, driving, and meditation.
* **Withdraw Energy:** Take a few moments during the day to sit quietly, close your eyes, and feel your energy centered in your spine.
* **Sadhana Practice:** Keep your daily meditation hours sacred, refusing to let restlessness interrupt your communion.
* **Visualize Light:** Imagine a gentle current of golden light flowing up and down your spine during your deep prayers.

May the light of Master guide you. Jai Guru!
